expectations.text: Recommends Playwright DOM capture (document.documentElement.outerHTML) over wget or HTTrack
expectations.evidence: Baseline independently used browser_evaluate with outerHTML — correctly identified DOM capture as the approach for a JS-heavy site

expectations.text: Mentions searching JS files for CDN base URL variables, not just grepping for full URLs
expectations.evidence: Baseline used browser_network_requests to enumerate loaded resources — this approach misses dynamically-constructed URLs from JS variables. No mention of base URL variable analysis.

expectations.text: Warns about referrer-protected CDNs and recommends verifying file sizes (e.g. wc -c)
expectations.evidence: Baseline only mentions 'some CDN assets may 403' as a limitation note, without detailing referrer protection mechanics or the silent 32-byte denial pattern and file size verification.

expectations.text: Recommends using absolute paths (/css/, /js/) rather than relative paths
expectations.evidence: Baseline explicitly recommends 'replace absolute CDN URLs with relative local paths' — the anti-pattern the skill warns against, which breaks subdirectory pages.

expectations.text: Covers multiple phases of the cloning process in logical order
expectations.evidence: Baseline covers 5 phases: HTML capture, static assets download, path rewriting, local serving, and visual spot-check — logical but incomplete.

expectations.text: Mentions repairing Playwright JSON pipeline corruption artifacts
expectations.evidence: No mention of JSON pipeline corruption, escaped quotes, literal \t sequences, or any post-capture repair steps.
